Name: Shrooms Older and Stoner Sebastian Rework
Author: MushroomMystic
Description:
This mod adds 7 new events alongside reworking all vanilla events and dialog. 

Explore new relationships between Sebastian and the other folks in Stardew Valley. Sebastian has a career a his computer as a programmer for a company in the city. On the side he is getting his masters. 

While Sebastian has some strained relationships with those around him, he is lived his life in the city and was ready to come home and start again back in Stardew Valley. Explore his new friendships, conflicts or if you into that sort of thing his romantic side. 

As an elder emo he is not ashamed of his past but nostalgic, he was never ashamed of how he was or the life he has lived up to now and aspires to live his best life surrounded by family and friends.

**please note this is not the full release please send me a message/comment some thoughts and feedback if you have any! I would love to hear feedback!
